title: Microsoft Sentinel Analytics Rules
description:
Imports the analytics rules deployed in a Microsoft Sentinel workspace into OpenCTI, read-only, through Azure Resource Manager. Each Scheduled or NRT rule becomes an Indicator whose pattern is the rule KQL query, with its severity. The rule is linked with `indicates` relationships to the MITRE ATT&CK techniques and sub-techniques it is mapped to, and recorded as deployed on the Microsoft Sentinel platform with its status (active when enabled, deployed when disabled, removed when deleted since the previous run).

These deployments feed the detection layer of the OpenCTI Threat-Informed Defense Matrix: which techniques used by your threats are actually detected, and where. The connector never creates, modifies or enables a rule in Microsoft Sentinel.
short_description: Imports the analytics rules deployed in Microsoft Sentinel as KQL Indicators linked to the ATT&CK techniques they detect and to the Sentinel platform they run on.
